title: Batch 1-37 strict suite certification request
description: Submission an independent verifier signs to move the Batch 1-37 strict suite from BLOCKED to CERTIFIED. Enforced by scripts/test-suite/run_strict_test_gate.py (validate_request_shape and verify_certification_request); this schema mirrors those checks so a verifier can validate a submission before presenting it to the gate. Exercise the end-to-end path with `make test-suite-certification-rehearsal`.

requested_at.description: Must not be more than five minutes in the future relative to gate execution.

expires_at.description: Must be strictly after requested_at and still in the future when the gate runs.

signer_id.description: Must equal the verifier id recorded on every passed case, and must match exactly one non-revoked trust anchor. A signer who executed the suite is not independent and must not appear here.

authorization_refs.description: References to the authorization under which the independent verification was performed.

control_digests.description: Must equal the control digests the gate computes from the suite; any drift is rejected.

case_bindings.description: Must bind the exact 408 result and evidence sets the gate computes, in the same order. A subset or reordering is rejected.
